result.rationale: The 'Begin the Discussion' branch in best.html.erb only renders when @topic_view was successfully constructed (`TopicView.new(topic_id, ...)`), i.e. a topic exists. When no topic_id is found, the controller explicitly renders the 'loading' template instead (`render 'loading'` in embed_controller.rb), and loading.html.erb contains no topic URL link at all. So the premise that this branch links to a possibly nonexistent topic misreads the diff. The only residual claim — a race where a topic is deleted between `topic_id_for_embed` and `TopicView.new` causing a 500 — is speculative, not a verifiab

adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, the code trusts TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url) and immediately does TopicView.new(topic_id, current_user, {best: 5}) with no rescue/fallback. Since TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed simply plucks the stored topic_id (TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: embed_url).pluck(:topic_id).first), it can return an ID for a topic that was deleted after the embed record was created. If TopicView.new raises when the topic is missing, the request would 500 inside the iframe rather than rendering the loading state. The finding’s specific mention of the 'Begin the Discussion' branch is slightly off (both branches link to @topic_view.topic.url), but the underlying missing error handling for a stale/deleted topic_id is diff-grounded.
